title: No-churn vanilla ice cream
intro: Cream and condensed milk: creamy, no machine, no hourly stirring.

steps.t: Put a 1 litre container, such as a loaf tin, in the freezer.
In a bowl mix the condensed milk with the vanilla seeds and salt.
Whip the cold cream to soft peaks: it shouldn't get too stiff.
Stir a third of the cream into the condensed milk, then gently fold in the rest.
Pour into the cold container, cover and freeze; then push the edges to the centre with a spatula.
steps.label: Freezer

steps.t: Smooth the top, press cling film onto it and freeze until firm.
steps.label: Freezer

steps.t: Take it out a few minutes before serving so it scoops nicely.
steps.label: Soften

tips.t: Before the last freeze, ripple in 3 tbsp of pistachio or hazelnut spread.
Serve it with a just-warmed brownie.
With cling film pressed on top it keeps 2 weeks without ice crystals.

title: Strawberry semifreddo
intro: Blended strawberries, cream and Greek yogurt: it slices cleanly and melts in your mouth.

steps.t: Line a 1 litre loaf tin with cling film, leaving it hanging over the sides.
Blend 300 g strawberries with the icing sugar and the juice of half the lemon; dice the rest.
Whip the cold cream to soft peaks.
Stir the yogurt into the strawberry purée, gently fold in the cream, then the diced strawberries.
Pour into the tin, smooth the top and cover with the overhanging film.
Freeze until firm right through the centre.
steps.label: Freezer

steps.t: Take it out, turn it onto a plate and wait a quarter of an hour before slicing.
steps.label: Soften

tips.t: Serve with fresh strawberries dressed with a few drops of balsamic vinegar and mint.
In summer swap the strawberries for ripe peaches or raspberries.

title: Coffee granita
intro: Strong coffee, sugar and patience: fine crystals and full flavour, Sicilian style.

ing.n: freshly made espresso or moka coffee

steps.t: Dissolve the sugar in the hot coffee and add the cold water.
Let it cool to room temperature.
steps.label: Cool

steps.t: Pour into a shallow metal container and put it in the freezer.
Once the edges have frozen, scrape with a fork, pulling the crystals into the centre.
steps.label: Freezer

steps.t: Back in the freezer, then scrape again, breaking up any big lumps.
steps.label: Freezer

steps.t: Freeze again, then scrape: the crystals are finer now.
steps.label: Freezer

steps.t: Last spell in the freezer and a last scrape: it should be soft and grainy.
steps.label: Freezer

steps.t: Serve straight away in chilled glasses.

tips.t: In Sicily it comes topped with whipped cream and a brioche for dunking.
A shallow metal container freezes faster and gives finer crystals.

title: Lemon sorbet
intro: Lemons, water and sugar blended twice: smooth even without an ice cream machine.

steps.t: Bring water, sugar and strips of peel from 1 lemon to the boil and simmer until the sugar dissolves.
steps.label: Syrup

steps.t: Let the syrup cool, then remove the peel.
steps.label: Cool

steps.t: Squeeze the lemons, strain the juice (you need about 200 ml) and stir it into the cold syrup.
Pour into a shallow container and freeze until solid at the edges and still soft in the middle.
steps.label: Freezer

steps.t: Blitz with a stick blender until pale, smooth and creamy.
Return it to the freezer, then blitz again for a few seconds before serving.
steps.label: Freezer

tips.t: Blend in a splash of vodka and prosecco at the last minute for a Venetian sgroppino.
Blend 4 basil or mint leaves into the syrup for a fresher sorbet.
